title: leucanthemum vulgare subsp. eliasii
intro: Leucanthemum vulgare subsp. eliasii, commonly known as a variant of the Oxford daisy or Oxeye daisy, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help in soothing digestive issues and reducing oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum vulgare subsp. eliasii include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
